scope: Six non-parametrised presentation hide/list/unhide declarations use temporary generated decks. Two new native test declarations inspect the retained manifest-backed S/P four-slide originals (one with two parameter rows, one with eleven corruption rows). Python's hidden-slide tool reports zero hidden slides for S; this is reader behaviour, not PowerPoint confirmation or canonical Gherkin execution.

gaps: Hiding slide 2 on a generated deck checks success or hidden response, not a byte-preserved retained four-slide source, exact hidden slide 3/visible control identities, or an application-confirmed PowerPoint original.
The generated input's hidden-slides response is checked only as a list; no exact slide membership, relationship identity, original archive custody or PowerPoint reopen is asserted.

The test authors three slides, requests hiding slide 2 and accepts success or hidden truthiness. It does not inspect a saved slide part, report the exact hidden set, compare manifest-backed source/control bytes or verify Office interpretation.
The generated deck hide-slide result is checked only as a dict. No output slide identity, package custody or control deck is asserted.
Removing a generated slide's show attribute is exercised, but the assertion only checks a dict result; no reopened exact slide visibility or source custody is measured.

A generated four-slide deck marks alternating slides hidden before listing, but the native assertion only checks that the response is a dict; exact hidden slide numbers and relationship identities are not asserted.

verifiedAspects: Two parameter rows inspect manifest-sealed S/P archives, four ordered slide IDs and internal relationship targets, S slide 3's namespaced p:show=0, absent unqualified show on all slides, and unchanged input bytes. The native reader reports four slides and zero reader-hidden slides on both inputs.
gaps: The reader's zero-hidden result does not establish PowerPoint display state; this native test does not select or execute the shared Gherkin case.

verifiedAspects: Eleven in-memory malformed marker, missing/duplicate/external/unsafe/wrong-type relationship, slide identity and missing part controls reject changed input structures without editing the originals.
gaps: Corruption controls cover the native inspector only; the canonical case is unselected and no PowerPoint-produced hidden-positive original has been verified.
